content: Penicillin G benzathine, marketed as Bicillin L-A, is provided in packages containing 10 disposable syringes. The product is available in the following configurations: 1. A 1 mL syringe containing 600,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with a 21-gauge, thin-wall, 1-inch needle designed for pediatric use. The National Drug Code (NDC) for this product is 60793-700-10. 2. A 2 mL syringe containing 1,200,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with a 21-gauge, thin-wall, 1.5-inch needle. The NDC for this product is 60793-701-10. 3. A 4 mL syringe containing 2,400,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with an 18-gauge, 1.5-inch needle. The NDC for this product is 60793-702-10. The product should be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature range of 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F). It must be protected from freezing.
